Contributor: Map47 Discussion Comment No.: 5 Comment: OSMI segnalava un problema alla relazione https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/20385035 in quanto tutti i membri erano contrassegnati come "inner". Aggiornando la relazione con JOSM sono state rimosse le etichette dalle way in quanto i dati già presenti nella relazione e contrassegnando le way come "outer". Az OSMI hibát jelzett a https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/20385035 jelentésben, mivel az összes elem „inner” jelöléssel volt ellátva. A jelentés JOSM-mal történő frissítése során eltávolítottuk a címkéket a way-ekről, mivel az adatok már szerepeltek a jelentésben, és a way-eket „outer” jelöléssel láttuk el. Date: 2026-03-30T14:42:05+02:00

Contributor: iandees Discussion Comment No.: 1 Comment: Hello! I noticed that node https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/3112167062 was moved a long distance in this changeset. This is a common mistake that happens when you click on a point and drag to move the map. The point moves with your mouse instead of the map. I moved things back to where they were before in https://www.openstreetmap.org/changeset/180602492, so no harm done! To avoid this in the future: - Try to click on an empty part of the map when you want to move around - If you see a point move by mistake, press Ctrl+Z (or Cmd+Z on Mac) to undo it Happy mapping! Date: 2026-03-29T20:25:04+02:00
